---
title: Clients
description: Gérez les profils clients et consultez leur historique de paiement.
---

import { Tabs, Tab } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

L’API Customers permet de créer, consulter, mettre à jour et gérer les profils clients liés à votre compte marchand.

## Créer un client

**Référence API (schéma complet) :** [Créer un client](/api/customers/CustomersController_create)

**L’essentiel :** `name` est obligatoire. Passez `email`, `phone_number`, `whatsapp_number`, l’adresse, `is_business` et `metadata` pour le préremplissage checkout et votre CRM.

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
import { LomiSDK } from '@lomi./sdk';

const lomi = new LomiSDK({
  apiKey: process.env.LOMI_API_KEY!,
  environment: 'live',
});

const customer = await lomi.customers.create({
  name: 'Amadou Ba',
  email: 'amadou.ba@example.com',
  phone_number: '+221771234567',
  country: 'Senegal',
  city: 'Dakar',
  is_business: false,
  metadata: {
    internal_id: 'USER_123',
  },
});

console.log(`Customer created: ${customer.id}`);
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
from lomi import LomiClient
import os

client = LomiClient(
    api_key=os.environ["LOMI_API_KEY"],
    environment="test"
)

customer = client.customers.create({
    "name": "Amadou Ba",
    "email": "amadou.ba@example.com",
    "phone_number": "+221771234567",
    "country": "Senegal",
    "city": "Dakar",
    "is_business": False,
    "metadata": {"internal_id": "USER_123"}
})

print(f"Customer created: {customer['id']}")
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.lomi.africa/customers" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Amadou Ba",
    "email": "amadou.ba@example.com",
    "phone_number": "+221771234567",
    "country": "Senegal",
    "city": "Dakar",
    "is_business": false,
    "metadata": {"internal_id": "USER_123"}
  }'
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

## Lister les clients

**Référence API :** [Lister les clients](/api/customers/CustomersController_findAll) — `search`, `type`, `status`, `page` et `pageSize`.

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
const customers = await lomi.customers.list({
  search: 'amadou',
  type: 'individual',
  status: 'active',
  page: 1,
  pageSize: 20,
});
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
customers = client.customers.list(
    search="amadou",
    type="individual",
    status="active",
    page=1,
    pageSize=20
)
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.lomi.africa/customers?search=amadou&type=individual&page=1&pageSize=20" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

### Réponse

```json
{
  "customers": [...],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "totalCount": 150,
    "totalPages": 8
  }
}
```

## Mettre à jour un client

**Référence API :** [Mettre à jour un client](/api/customers/CustomersController_update) — tous les champs du corps sont facultatifs.

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
const updated = await lomi.customers.update('cus_abc123...', {
  email: 'new.email@example.com',
  metadata: { vip: true },
});
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
updated = client.customers.update('cus_abc123...', {
    "email": "new.email@example.com",
    "metadata": {"vip": True}
})
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.lomi.africa/customers/cus_abc123..." \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "new.email@example.com"}'
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

## Transactions d’un client

**Référence API :** [Transactions client](/api/customers/CustomersController_getTransactions)

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "Python", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
const transactions = await lomi.customers.getTransactions('cus_abc123...');

transactions.forEach(tx => {
  console.log(`${tx.description}: ${tx.gross_amount} ${tx.currency_code}`);
});
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="Python">
```python
transactions = client.customers.get_transactions('cus_abc123...')

for tx in transactions:
    print(f"{tx['description']}: {tx['gross_amount']} {tx['currency_code']}")
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.lomi.africa/customers/cus_abc123.../transactions" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>

### Réponse

```json
[
  {
    "transaction_id": "tx_def456...",
    "description": "Payment for Product A",
    "gross_amount": 10000,
    "currency_code": "XOF",
    "status": "completed",
    "created_at": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
  }
]
```

## Créer une session de lancement portail client

**Référence API :** [Session de lancement portail](/api/customers/CustomersController_createPortalLaunchSession)

Génère une URL portail hébergée à usage unique depuis votre backend. Retourne `launch_url` pour la redirection. Voir [Portail client](/build/customer-portal) pour les flux, la sécurité et la checklist production.

<Tabs items={["TypeScript", "cURL"]}>

<Tab value="TypeScript">
```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

const { data: launch } = await axios.post(
  'https://api.lomi.africa/customers/cus_abc123.../portal-launch-session',
  {
    return_url: 'https://merchant.example.com/account',
    flow_type: 'subscription_cancel',
    flow_subscription_id: 'sub_abc123...',
    flow_after_completion_url:
      'https://merchant.example.com/account/subscription-cancelled',
  },
  {
    headers: {
      'X-API-KEY': process.env.LOMI_API_KEY!,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
  },
);

window.location.href = launch.launch_url;
```
</Tab>

<Tab value="cURL">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.lomi.africa/customers/cus_abc123.../portal-launch-session" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "return_url": "https://merchant.example.com/account",
    "flow_type": "subscription_cancel",
    "flow_subscription_id": "sub_abc123...",
    "flow_after_completion_url": "https://merchant.example.com/account/subscription-cancelled"
  }'
```
</Tab>

</Tabs>
